Usage:  circleci config audit [<path>] [flags]

Flags:
      --format string         output format: text or sarif (default "text")
  -h, --help                  help for audit
      --json                  Output as JSON
      --min-severity string   lowest severity to report: low, medium or high (default "low")
      --online                also check project, org and context settings (read-only API calls)
      --project string        project slug for --online (e.g. gh/org/repo); defaults to the git remote
